query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT tenant FROM rum.web_vitals WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY ORDER BY tenant
SELECT DISTINCT page_type FROM rum.web_vitals WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY ORDER BY page_type
SELECT DISTINCT device FROM rum.web_vitals WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY ORDER BY device
SELECT DISTINCT navigation_type FROM rum.web_vitals WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY ORDER BY navigation_type

panels.title: LCP p75 (28 days)
panels.description: p75 (linear interpolation, quantileExactInclusive) over per-page-view values deduped by metric id, fixed 28-day window like CrUX. Thresholds: Core Web Vitals good / poor.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(value) AS p75, count() AS page_views FROM (
  SELECT tenant, metric, id,
    argMax(value, ts) AS value, argMax(rating, ts) AS rating,
    argMax(page_type, ts) AS page_type, argMax(device, ts) AS device,
    argMax(navigation_type, ts) AS navigation_type, argMax(attribution, ts) AS attribution,
    min(ts) AS first_ts
  FROM rum.web_vitals
  WHERE tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}) AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
  GROUP BY tenant, metric, id
)
WHERE page_type IN (${page_type:singlequote}) AND device IN (${device:singlequote}) AND navigation_type IN (${navigation_type:singlequote}) AND metric = 'LCP'

panels.title: Daily p75: LCP, INP, FCP, TTFB (ms)
panels.description: Per day of first sighting of the page view, deduped by metric id. Raw data is kept 90 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(first_ts) AS time, metric, quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(value) AS p75 FROM (
  SELECT tenant, metric, id,
    argMax(value, ts) AS value, argMax(rating, ts) AS rating,
    argMax(page_type, ts) AS page_type, argMax(device, ts) AS device,
    argMax(navigation_type, ts) AS navigation_type, argMax(attribution, ts) AS attribution,
    min(ts) AS first_ts
  FROM rum.web_vitals
  WHERE tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY tenant, metric, id
)
WHERE page_type IN (${page_type:singlequote}) AND device IN (${device:singlequote}) AND navigation_type IN (${navigation_type:singlequote}) AND metric != 'CLS' GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfDay(first_ts) AS time, metric, quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(value) AS p75 FROM (
  SELECT tenant, metric, id,
    argMax(value, ts) AS value, argMax(rating, ts) AS rating,
    argMax(page_type, ts) AS page_type, argMax(device, ts) AS device,
    argMax(navigation_type, ts) AS navigation_type, argMax(attribution, ts) AS attribution,
    min(ts) AS first_ts
  FROM rum.web_vitals
  WHERE tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}) AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY tenant, metric, id
)
WHERE page_type IN (${page_type:singlequote}) AND device IN (${device:singlequote}) AND navigation_type IN (${navigation_type:singlequote}) AND metric = 'CLS' GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

SELECT metric, count() AS page_views, round(countIf(rating = 'good') / count() * 100, 1) AS good_pct, round(countIf(rating = 'needs-improvement') / count() * 100, 1) AS needs_improvement_pct, round(countIf(rating = 'poor') / count() * 100, 1) AS poor_pct FROM (
  SELECT tenant, metric, id,
    argMax(value, ts) AS value, argMax(rating, ts) AS rating,
    argMax(page_type, ts) AS page_type, argMax(device, ts) AS device,
    argMax(navigation_type, ts) AS navigation_type, argMax(attribution, ts) AS attribution,
    min(ts) AS first_ts
  FROM rum.web_vitals
  WHERE tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}) AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
  GROUP BY tenant, metric, id
)
WHERE page_type IN (${page_type:singlequote}) AND device IN (${device:singlequote}) AND navigation_type IN (${navigation_type:singlequote}) GROUP BY metric ORDER BY metric

SELECT page_type, metric, count() AS page_views, round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(value), 3) AS p75 FROM (
  SELECT tenant, metric, id,
    argMax(value, ts) AS value, argMax(rating, ts) AS rating,
    argMax(page_type, ts) AS page_type, argMax(device, ts) AS device,
    argMax(navigation_type, ts) AS navigation_type, argMax(attribution, ts) AS attribution,
    min(ts) AS first_ts
  FROM rum.web_vitals
  WHERE tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}) AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
  GROUP BY tenant, metric, id
)
WHERE page_type IN (${page_type:singlequote}) AND device IN (${device:singlequote}) AND navigation_type IN (${navigation_type:singlequote}) GROUP BY page_type, metric ORDER BY page_type, metric

panels.title: Daily p75 from aggregates (13 months)
panels.description: rum.web_vitals_daily (refreshed hourly, deduped); quantileMerge over the selected segments.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, metric, quantileMerge(0.75)(p75_state) AS p75 FROM rum.web_vitals_daily FINAL WHERE tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}) AND page_type IN (${page_type:singlequote}) AND device IN (${device:singlequote}) AND navigation_type IN (${navigation_type:singlequote}) AND metric != 'CLS' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(day)) GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

panels.title: LCP: elements (28 days)
panels.description: LCP element (CSS selector) per page view. Phases: time to first byte → resource load delay → resource load duration → element render delay.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(JSONExtractString(attribution, 'target') = '', '(no element)', JSONExtractString(attribution, 'target')) AS element,
  topK(1)(page_type)[1] AS main_page_type, count() AS page_views, round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(value)) AS lcp_p75, round(countIf(rating = 'poor') / count() * 100, 1) AS poor_pct,
  round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(JSONExtractFloat(attribution, 'timeToFirstByte'))) AS ttfb_p75,
  round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(JSONExtractFloat(attribution, 'resourceLoadDelay'))) AS load_delay_p75,
  round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(JSONExtractFloat(attribution, 'resourceLoadDuration'))) AS load_duration_p75,
  round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(JSONExtractFloat(attribution, 'elementRenderDelay'))) AS render_delay_p75,
  topK(1)(JSONExtractString(attribution, 'url'))[1] AS top_resource
FROM (
  SELECT tenant, metric, id,
    argMax(value, ts) AS value, argMax(rating, ts) AS rating,
    argMax(page_type, ts) AS page_type, argMax(device, ts) AS device,
    argMax(navigation_type, ts) AS navigation_type, argMax(attribution, ts) AS attribution,
    min(ts) AS first_ts
  FROM rum.web_vitals
  WHERE tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}) AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
  GROUP BY tenant, metric, id
)
WHERE page_type IN (${page_type:singlequote}) AND device IN (${device:singlequote}) AND navigation_type IN (${navigation_type:singlequote}) AND metric = 'LCP'
GROUP BY element ORDER BY page_views * lcp_p75 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: CLS: shifting elements (28 days)
panels.description: Element with the largest single layout shift in the page view (web-vitals reports only the largest one).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(JSONExtractString(attribution, 'largestShiftTarget') = '', '(no element)', JSONExtractString(attribution, 'largestShiftTarget')) AS element,
  topK(1)(page_type)[1] AS main_page_type, count() AS page_views,
  round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(value), 3) AS cls_p75, round(countIf(rating = 'poor') / count() * 100, 1) AS poor_pct,
  round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(JSONExtractFloat(attribution, 'largestShiftValue')), 3) AS largest_shift_p75,
  round(quantileExactInclusive(0.5)(JSONExtractFloat(attribution, 'largestShiftTime'))) AS shift_time_median,
  topK(1)(JSONExtractString(attribution, 'loadState'))[1] AS load_state
FROM (
  SELECT tenant, metric, id,
    argMax(value, ts) AS value, argMax(rating, ts) AS rating,
    argMax(page_type, ts) AS page_type, argMax(device, ts) AS device,
    argMax(navigation_type, ts) AS navigation_type, argMax(attribution, ts) AS attribution,
    min(ts) AS first_ts
  FROM rum.web_vitals
  WHERE tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}) AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
  GROUP BY tenant, metric, id
)
WHERE page_type IN (${page_type:singlequote}) AND device IN (${device:singlequote}) AND navigation_type IN (${navigation_type:singlequote}) AND metric = 'CLS' AND value > 0
GROUP BY element ORDER BY page_views * cls_p75 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: INP: elements (28 days)
panels.description: Interaction target per page view. Phases: input delay (main thread busy) → processing (event handlers) → presentation delay (style, layout, paint).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(JSONExtractString(attribution, 'interactionTarget') = '', '(no element)', JSONExtractString(attribution, 'interactionTarget')) AS element,
  topK(1)(JSONExtractString(attribution, 'interactionType'))[1] AS type,
  topK(1)(page_type)[1] AS main_page_type, count() AS page_views, round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(value)) AS inp_p75, round(countIf(rating = 'poor') / count() * 100, 1) AS poor_pct,
  round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(JSONExtractFloat(attribution, 'inputDelay'))) AS input_delay_p75,
  round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(JSONExtractFloat(attribution, 'processingDuration'))) AS processing_p75,
  round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(JSONExtractFloat(attribution, 'presentationDelay'))) AS presentation_p75,
  topK(1)(JSONExtractString(attribution, 'loadState'))[1] AS load_state
FROM (
  SELECT tenant, metric, id,
    argMax(value, ts) AS value, argMax(rating, ts) AS rating,
    argMax(page_type, ts) AS page_type, argMax(device, ts) AS device,
    argMax(navigation_type, ts) AS navigation_type, argMax(attribution, ts) AS attribution,
    min(ts) AS first_ts
  FROM rum.web_vitals
  WHERE tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}) AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
  GROUP BY tenant, metric, id
)
WHERE page_type IN (${page_type:singlequote}) AND device IN (${device:singlequote}) AND navigation_type IN (${navigation_type:singlequote}) AND metric = 'INP'
GROUP BY element ORDER BY page_views * inp_p75 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: INP: longest scripts (28 days)
panels.description: Longest script (Long Animation Frames) during the INP interaction: source file without query string and its invoker, e.g. BUTTON#id.onclick.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(JSONExtractString(attribution, 'longestScript', 'sourceURL') = '', '(unknown or inline)', JSONExtractString(attribution, 'longestScript', 'sourceURL')) AS script,
  JSONExtractString(attribution, 'longestScript', 'invoker') AS invoker,
  topK(1)(JSONExtractString(attribution, 'longestScript', 'subpart'))[1] AS phase,
  count() AS page_views, round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(value)) AS inp_p75,
  round(quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(JSONExtractFloat(attribution, 'longestScript', 'duration'))) AS script_duration_p75
FROM (
  SELECT tenant, metric, id,
    argMax(value, ts) AS value, argMax(rating, ts) AS rating,
    argMax(page_type, ts) AS page_type, argMax(device, ts) AS device,
    argMax(navigation_type, ts) AS navigation_type, argMax(attribution, ts) AS attribution,
    min(ts) AS first_ts
  FROM rum.web_vitals
  WHERE tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}) AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY
  GROUP BY tenant, metric, id
)
WHERE page_type IN (${page_type:singlequote}) AND device IN (${device:singlequote}) AND navigation_type IN (${navigation_type:singlequote}) AND metric = 'INP' AND JSONHas(attribution, 'longestScript')
GROUP BY script, invoker ORDER BY page_views * script_duration_p75 DESC LIMIT 50
